stories.headline: 2nd Bombing Suspect Caught After Frenzied Hunt Paralyzes Boston
stories.summary: The teenage suspect in the Boston Marathon bombings, Dzhokhar A. Tsarnaev, was taken into custody in Watertown, Mass., after a search that left his brother dead and the Boston area virtually shut down.

stories.headline: John Lennon of Beatles Is Killed; Suspect Held in Shooting at Dakota; Wife Reported Unhurt John Lennon Shot to Death; Suspect Is Seized at Dakota Obtained Autograph Earlier 'Crouching in Archway' Continued to Write Songs Emblem of the 60's
stories.summary: John Lennon, one of the four Beatles was shot and killed last night while entering the apartment building where he lived, the Dakota, on Manhattan's Upper West Side. A suspect was seized at the scene.

stories.summary: WASHINGTON, --Presidentelect Ronald Reagan, drawing on both the Eastern establishment and his West Coast political associates, has decided on the four men he wants to form the inner ring of his Cabinet, well-placed Republican sources said today.

stories.summary: WARSAW, --Meeting in an atmosphere of crisis, the Communist Party's Central Committee dismissed four members of the ruling Politburo today and returned a former Interior Minister to that body.

stories.headline: Senate Rejects Raise for Congress; House Yields on Abortion Measure; Pay Bill's Defeat Is Seen as Early Loss for Reagan-- Agency Appropriations Last Hurdle of the Session 34,000 Employees Affected House Acts on Voice Vote Senate Rejects Raise; House Approves Abortion Rules
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, --The Senate tonight handed President-elect Ronald Reagan his first legislative defeat by rejecting his request for a $10,000-a-year Congressional pay increase that also would benefit senior Government officials. The vote was 62 to 8.
